at least 792 bytes, derived from the tree's record format; the 20-port record is not defined (IOBoard.md:248). record_t is a 20-byte header (magic, zeros, zeros_inv 4 bytes each; crc, version 2 each; seq 4) plus out_store_t, whose uint16 registers are 4 per slot and 4 per channel (firmware/iomcu/src/out_store.c:99-107; out_store.h:64-67; link_pages.h:75-76, :92, :125). Today 8 slots and 8 channels give 148 bytes. With one slot per port, 20 slots, and 27 channels (19 single-channel ports plus 8 on the one port switched to PPM, IOBoard.md:64, :250), one record is 20 + 2 × (20 × 4 + 27 × 4) = 396 bytes. The store keeps the record from before a save readable while the next is written (out_store.c:30-33; out_store_map.h:22-33), so it holds 2 records at least: 792 bytes. The flash store occupies 8,192 bytes (IOBoard.md:115). Feeds Q8 only

report.value: FRAM, Q8 option FRAM, first-ranked. 32,768 bytes against 792 needed (V247); 10^12 read/write cycles a byte at ≤ 85 °C against 3,200,000 saves (V248); no programming wait. A 396-byte record is (3 + 396) x 9 = 3,591 SCL cycles: 9.0 ms at 400 kHz, 3.6 ms at its 1 MHz maximum. Interrupts stay on and the core keeps running from flash through the transfer, so a save stops no CAN reception, against the flash store's packaged-part 3 ms page program and 400 ms sector erase with interrupts off (IOBoard.md:116). Leaving flash frees the store's 8,192 bytes, so the image limit becomes 2,097,152 bytes, and the boot-time erase disappears. Address 0x50 to 0x57 by A2 to A0; 2.7 to 5.5 V; retention 10 years at 85 °C, 95 years at 55 °C. JLCPCB 6,523 (15:10:12Z), Digi-Key 1,984 (15:11:31Z)
